// include: This is the exact set of files uploaded to production - nothing else is
sent, so docs sources, tests and CI config stay out of the deployment.
docs/.vitepress/dist is gitignored build output; naming it here as a
plain path (never a glob) overrides .gitignore for the uploader, which
is the only reason /docs exists in production. `just deploy` builds it
first and refuses to deploy if it is missing.

// exclude: Deliberately no top-level `exclude`: `deno deploy` builds the set of files
it uploads from this workspace config, so anything excluded here is also
missing from production. Exclusions belong in the `fmt`/`lint` blocks.
